title: Lifesteal Duels
description: This plugin adds a pvp server like feel to lifesteal servers
body:
With this plugin, server admins can easily set up dueling arenas using WorldEdit. **Just use //wand to select an area and run /duel setarena. Players can then challenge each other with /duel playername and respond with /duel accept or /duel decline.**

_**During a duel:**_

Players cannot escape the arena or use other commands.

Leaving the arena automatically pushes players back into the fight.

When a player dies, the winner has 30 seconds to loot their opponent before being teleported back to their original location.

Perfect for servers that want clean, controlled PvP without exploits or unfair escapes!
